Detailed information and requirements for the procurement contract are set out in the tender documentation Annex Specification of Requirements, which sets out the minimum and quality requirements for the services offered. The procurement is subject to the Public Procurement Act 1397/2016. The procedure used is an open procedure exceeding the EU threshold. The tenderer must bid for the entirety. Alternative tenders are not accepted. Detailed tender requirements are set out in the tender documentation Annex Specification of Requirements, which sets out the minimum and quality requirements for the services offered.

signal.title: Healthcare at Short-Term Holding Facilities
signal.description: The Home Office seeks to engage suppliers for the provision of healthcare services at short-term holding facilities and ports of entry across the UK. These services will support individuals whilst detained for short periods of time including in, but not limited to, short-term holding facilities as defined under the Short-Term Holding Facilities Rules 2018 (as amended), where individuals can be held up to 24 hours. The Authority is seeking a flexible, responsive and value for money healthcare solution that meets the basic needs of individuals and can be flexible to different service environments; the short-term holding facilities are located at different location types across the UK which include Airports, Seaports, and Reporting Centres. Remote Healthcare Services: This market engagement aims to understand supplier capabilities and appetite, to further refine the Authority’s specification and gather feedback on the proposed approach of remote healthcare services. This includes gaining further understanding of both the provision of Clinicians to undertake remote consultations and the provision of IT infrastructure required to deliver a remote only healthcare service. The content of this Notice, including the nature of services and the start date of the contract, is subject to change. The contract is expected to commence in early 2028. The length of contract has not been confirmed yet. For the purposes of this Preliminary Market Engagement Notice, the estimated contract value has been listed as £0. This figure does not reflect the expected final value of the contract. The actual estimated value is currently being finalised and will be shared later.

signal.title: Stadtverwaltung Koblenz_Bereitstellung Mitarbeiterberatung/Gesundheitsmanagement
signal.description: Das Angebot der Mitarbeiterberatung für die Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter der Stadt Koblenz umfasst ein Beratungsangebot in Bezug auf die nachgenannten Beratungsanlässe unter 1.3.1 und die erweiterten Leistungen unter 1.3.2. Lot LOT-0001: Stadtverwaltung Koblenz_Bereitstellung Mitarbeiterberatung/Gesundheitsmanagement. 1.3.1 Die nachgenannten Leistungen beziehen sich auf folgende Beratungsanlässe: - Konfliktidentifikation - Belastungssituationen (Arbeitsplatz, persönliche) - Psychische und psychosomatische Probleme - Suchtmittelprobleme und Abhängigkeit - Krisenbewältigung nach Extremerfahrungen (z.B. Tod, Suizid, Unfall, gewalttätige Übergriffe im beruflichen Umfeld) - Notfallsituationen, insbesondere bei Gefahr für Leib und Leben - Beratung von Führungskräften des AG im Umgang mit Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern die gesundheitlich auffällig geworden sind - Facharztvermittlung und Terminservice 1.3.2. Darüber hinaus bezieht sich die erweiterte Leistung des AN auf: - Mitarbeit im Betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement: Die vom AN zu erbringende Leistung umfasst eine aktive Mitarbeit im Rahmen des betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagements und die damit verbundene Teilnahme an entsprechenden Arbeitsgruppen. Die vertragliche Leistung umfasst die Teilnahme von 4 Stunden pro Kalenderjahr. Darüberhinausgehender vom AG diesbezüglich geforderter Unterstützungsbedarf wird mit einem im Rahmen der Nebenleistung festgelegten Stundensatz vom AN gesondert in Rechnung gestellt. - Erstellung jährlicher Berichte zur Schilderung des Umfangs und Anlässe der Beratungen sowie Empfehlungen für das betriebliche Gesundheitsmanagement und die Dienststellenleitung: Es wird jährlich - jeweils zum 02.01. - vonseiten des AN eine aussagekräftige Dokumentation erstellt und unaufgefordert dem AG vorgelegt. Diese enthält den tatsächlichen Umfang der Inanspruchnahme - insbesondere Anzahl der Kontakte telefonisch und persönlich - sowie anonymisierte Inhalte der Beratungsleistung einschließlich einer Spezifizierung der gesundheitlichen Problemstellungen. Ferner wird eine fachlich fundierte Einschätzung der Auswertung erwartet. Darüber hinaus eine Empfehlung zur Entwicklung von Handlungsstrategien auf der Verhaltens- und Verhältnisebene. Dies wird in einem persönlichen Bilanzierungsgespräch auf der Ebene der Dienststellenleitung mit einem zeitlichen Umfang von 2 Zeitstunden umfassend erläutert. - Unterstützung bei Bekanntmachung der externen Mitarbeiterberatung und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit: Die Beratungsstelle unterstützt aktiv den Prozess der internen Kommunikation zur Mitarbeiterberatung. Hierzu zählt insbesondere die Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung einer innerbetrieblichen Informationsbroschüre sowie Begleitung von Infoständen/Präsentation bei Veranstaltungen (Gesundheitsaktionen, Personalversammlung o.ä). Ferner wird erwartet, dass der AN Veröffentlichungen (beispielsweise auf der Intranetseite) mit Fachbeiträgen unterstützt. - Unabhängig von der anlassbezogenen Beratung wird eine telefonische Unterstützung hinsichtlich dringend notwendiger Terminvereinbarungen bzw. Vermittlung bei/zu Fachärzten und psychologischen Psychotherapeuten auf Anfrage gewünscht. - Es wird zugesichert, dass im Rahmen der geltenden Öffnungszeiten ein aussagefähiger Drogencheck über Urin und Atemluftkontrolle erfolgen kann. Diese Leistung wird im Einzelfall gesondert beauftragt und gesondert abgerechnet. - Es wird seitens des AG gewünscht, dass die Beantragung einer Reha auf Anfrage oder im Rahmen eines bestehenden Beratungsprozesses im psychosomatischen Kontext geleistet wird. Die Abrechnung erfolgt unmittelbar mit dem Antragsteller. - Es wird gewünscht, dass im Rahmen der Fallberatung eine notwendige Zusammenarbeit mit dem AG sowie externen Fachstellen (z.B. Therapiepraxen, Kliniken, Fachdiensten, Reha-Einrichtungen) erfolgt. - Kooperationen mit Therapiepraxen, Kliniken, Fachdiensten und Reha-Einrichtungen werden begrüßt. Falls solche Kooperationen bestehen, sind diese nachzuweisen.

translation.title: Koblenz City Administration_Provision of Employee Counselling / Health Management
translation.description: The employee counselling offering for the employees of Stadt Koblenz comprises a counselling offering with regard to the counselling occasions named below under 1.3.1 and the extended services under 1.3.2. Lot LOT-0001: Koblenz City Administration_Provision of Employee Counselling / Health Management. 1.3.1 The services named below relate to the following counselling occasions: - Conflict identification - Stress situations (workplace, personal) - Psychological and psychosomatic problems - Substance abuse problems and dependency - Crisis management following extreme experiences (e.g. death, suicide, accident, violent attacks in a professional environment) - Emergency situations, in particular where there is a danger to life and limb - Advising management staff of the contracting authority on dealing with employees who have developed conspicuous health issues - Specialist referral and appointment service 1.3.2. In addition, the contractor's extended service relates to: - Participation in company health management: The service to be provided by the contractor comprises active participation within the scope of company health management and the associated participation in relevant working groups. The contractual service comprises the participation of 4 hours per calendar year. Any additional support requirements requested by the contracting authority in this regard shall be invoiced separately by the contractor using an hourly rate established as an ancillary service. - Preparation of annual reports detailing the scope and occasions of the counselling sessions as well as recommendations for company health management and the department management: Comprehensive documentation shall be prepared by the contractor annually - by 02.01 each year - and submitted to the contracting authority unsolicited. This shall contain the actual scope of utilisation - in particular the number of telephone and personal contacts - as well as anonymised contents of the counselling service including a specification of the health-related issues. Furthermore, a professionally sound assessment of the evaluation is expected. In addition, a recommendation for the development of action strategies at the behavioural and situational level. This shall be explained comprehensively in a personal review meeting at the department management level with a duration of 2 hours. - Support in publicising the external employee counselling and public relations work: The counselling centre actively supports the process of internal communication regarding employee counselling. This includes in particular participation in the development of an internal company information brochure as well as accompanying info stands/presentations at events (health campaigns, staff assemblies or similar). Furthermore, it is expected that the contractor supports publications (for example on the intranet page) with specialist articles. - Independently of the occasion-related counselling, telephone support regarding urgently required appointment scheduling or referral to/for medical specialists and psychological psychotherapists is requested upon request. - It is guaranteed that, within the applicable opening hours, a meaningful drug check via urine and breath analysis can be carried out. This service shall be commissioned separately in individual cases and billed separately. - It is desired by the contracting authority that the application for rehabilitation is provided upon request or within the framework of an existing counselling process in a psychosomatic context. Billing shall take place directly with the applicant. - It is desired that, within the framework of case counselling, necessary cooperation with the contracting authority as well as external specialist centres (e.g. therapy practices, clinics, specialist services, rehabilitation facilities) takes place. - Cooperation with therapy practices, clinics, specialist services and rehabilitation facilities is welcomed. If such cooperation exists, evidence of this must be provided.

signal.title: Provision of Planned Heritable Asset Valuations
signal.description: The Scottish Police Authority (known as the “the Authority”) requires a suitably qualified and experienced Contractor to undertake planned heritable asset valuations of its properties - land, building and radio sites. This procurement will result in the appointment if a single Contractor. The successful contactor must provide valuers who are current, registered members of the Royal Institute of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) and all valuations must be carried out in full accordance with the RICS (Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors) Valuation - Global Standards. The Authority is re-tendering this requirement to ensure the engagement of a competent and reliable provider. The estate comprises approximately 500 assets, covering operational and non-operational properties. The assets represent a wide range of property types and ages, including heritage and listed buildings, many of which are in varied states of condition. The valuations must be carried out in accordance with the RICS (Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors) Valuation - Global Standards, incorporating International Standards (IVS) effective 31 January 2025, and having regard to the UK National Supplement effective from 1 May 2024. The contract is expected to commence on 1st October 2025 for an initial period of three years, with the option to extend for up to two additional 12-month periods, subject to the Authority’s discretion. signal.title: Selección de suministradores y establecimiento de las bases que regirán en los contratos de suministro de ordenadores y tabletas que realice la UZ derivados de este Acuerdo Marco, en 2 lotes: Lote 1: ordenadores personales con sistema operativo macOS y Lote 2: tabletas con sistema operativo IOS.
signal.description: Las denominadas Tecnologías de la Información y la Comunicación (TIC) se desarrollaron a finales del siglo pasado y son herramientas de amplia utilización desde 1995. En el entorno universitario puede afirmarse que son herramientas de utilización global (por todos los universitarios) desde finales de la década de los 90 del siglo pasado. Desde esas fechas ya no se entiende, ni puede desarrollarse normalmente, la actividad de ningún universitario (ya sea PDI, estudiante o PTGAS) sin utilizar el correo electrónico o el acceso a información a través de web, o la docencia sin las utilidades del campus virtual, etc. Y día a día van incorporándose nuevas aplicaciones que mejoran y facilitan el trabajo cotidiano de los universitarios (videoconferencia, herramientas de trabajo colaborativo, etc.) Consecuencia directa de este cambio en las condiciones de trabajo de los universitarios es que una (si no la primera) de las herramientas básicas del puesto de trabajo de cualquier universitario es su ordenador personal y sus dispositivos móviles; máquinas a través de las cuales pueden utilizarse esas herramientas de trabajo sin las que no puede desarrollarse la actividad cotidiana. La Universidad de Zaragoza precisa, por tanto, adquirir ordenadores personales y dispositivos móviles para su uso en todos sus ámbitos de actuación: docencia, investigación y gestión universitaria. Dentro de cada uno de estos ámbitos (en especial en docencia e investigación) las necesidades no son uniformes puesto que los entornos de trabajo son muy diferentes (filosofía, derecho, informática, etc.). Por otro lado, es muy difícil (por no decir imposible) planificar con suficiente antelación las necesidades de cada grupo puesto que las fuentes de financiación son diversas y no predecibles con antelación. El acuerdo marco es la forma idónea para cubrir las necesidades de la universidad puesto que permite homogeneizar las compras permitiendo que cada unidad las realice cuando sea necesario. El procedimiento está subdividido en 2 lotes: 1. Lote 1 dedicado a la adquisición de ordenadores personales con sistema operativo macOS, sus periféricos y accesorios. 2. Lote 2 incluye las tabletas (tablets en terminología inglesa) con sistema operativo IOS, cada vez de más utilización por su transportabilidad Lote 1: ordenadores personales con sistema operativo macOS; Lote 2: tabletas con sistema operativo IOS.
signal.buyer_name: Rectorado de la Universidad de Zaragoza

translation.title: Selection of suppliers and establishment of the rules governing contracts for the supply of computers and tablets carried out by the UZ resulting from this Framework Agreement, in 2 lots: Lot 1: personal computers with macOS operating system and Lot 2: tablets with IOS operating system.
translation.description: Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) were developed at the end of the last century and have been widely used tools since 1995. In the university environment, it can be stated that they have been tools of global use (by all university members) since the late 90s of the last century. Since those dates, the activity of any university member (whether PDI, student or PTGAS) is no longer understood, nor can it be carried out normally, without using electronic mail or web-based information access, or teaching without the utilities of the virtual campus, etc. Day by day, new applications are incorporated that improve and facilitate the daily work of university members (videoconferencing, collaborative work tools, etc.). A direct consequence of this change in the working conditions of university members is that one of the basic tools (if not the first) of the workplace of any university member is their personal computer and mobile devices; machines through which these work tools can be used without which daily activity cannot be carried out. The University of Zaragoza therefore requires the acquisition of personal computers and mobile devices for use in all its areas of activity: teaching, research and university management. Within each of these areas (especially in teaching and research) needs are not uniform since working environments are very different (philosophy, law, computer science, etc.). On the other hand, it is very difficult (not to say impossible) to plan the needs of each group sufficiently in advance since funding sources are diverse and cannot be predicted in advance. The framework agreement is the ideal way to cover the university's needs since it allows purchases to be standardised, enabling each unit to make them when necessary. The procedure is subdivided into 2 lots: 1. Lot 1 dedicated to the acquisition of personal computers with macOS operating system, their peripherals and accessories. 2. Lot 2 includes tablets (tablets in English terminology) with IOS operating system, increasingly used due to their portability Lot 1: personal computers with macOS operating system; Lot 2: tablets with IOS operating system.

signal.title: Space Technology Research, Development, Demonstration, and Infusion (SpaceTech REDDI-2026)
signal.description: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) Headquarters, Space Technology Mission Directorate (STMD) will be releasing an Umbrella NASA Research Announcement (NRA) titled “Space Technology Research, Development, Demonstration, and Infusion-2026 (SpaceTech-REDDI-2026)” on or about December 9, 2025. The solicitation is available by opening the NSPIRES homepage at https://nspires.nasaprs.com/ , selecting “Open” under "Solicitations," and searching "Space Technology Research, Development, Demonstration, and Infusion-2026 (SpaceTech-REDDI-2026)" un- der Solicitation #/Keyword(s). Proposals will be solicited through Appendices issued under this Umbrella SpaceTech-REDDI-2026 Solicitation, as technology topics are defined and funding is made available. See STMD Solicitations and Opportunities ( https://www.nasa.gov/stmd-solicitations-and-opportunities/ ) for anticipated releases. Once new Appendices are released, interested parties will be able to access the Appendices by selecting “Open” under "Solicitations," and searching “SpaceTech- REDDI-2026” in the “Solicitation #/ Keyword(s)” search area, and then selecting “List of Open Program Elements”. It is anticipated that this Umbrella NRA Solicitation (SpaceTech-REDDI-2026) will be open for one year and Umbrella SpaceTech-REDDI Solicitations will be issued annually. NASA STMD leads the development, demonstration, and infusion of transformational space technologies that solve critical stakeholder needs. As the tech base for civil space, STMD advances technology to sup- port future NASA, other government, and commercial missions. STMD investments aim to (1) advance U.S. space technology innovation and competitiveness in a global context, (2) encourage technology driven economic growth with an emphasis on the expanding space economy, and (3) inspire and develop a powerful U.S. aerospace technology community. STMD bolsters and funds ideas from entrepreneurs, researchers, and innovators across the country. Space technology research and development occurs at NASA centers, universi- ties, national labs, and small businesses. Interested proposers should monitor the NSPIRES website. NASA Headquarters maintains an electronic notification system to alert interested parties of program announcements, including solicitations and associated amendments. Subscription to this service is free to all registered users of NSPIRES at https://nspires.nasaprs.com . To add or change a subscription to the electronic notification system for a specific pro- gram or a NASA Mission Directorate, users should login to the database system and select “Account Management,” then “Email Subscriptions.” It is the responsibility of the prospective proposer to check this solicitation’s NSPIRES page for updates. Further questions concerning the Space Tech-REDDI-2026 solicitation may be sub- mitted to: HQ-STMD-SpaceTech-REDDI@nasaprs.com . Responses to inquiries will be answered by e-mail and may also be included in the Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) document located on the NSPIRES page associated with the solicitation; anonymity of persons/institutions who submit questions will be preserved.

signal.description: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board are seeking a contract for ophthalmic services within the central and West integrated health community, including all ophthalmology patients, service users and families/carers. The service provider will be expected to work with Key stakeholders across ophthalmic services within the central and West integrated health community, including all ophthalmology patients, service users and families/carers. Collaborative working within the Multi-disciplinary team (MDT) will be a key aspect of this role. The service provider is expected to provide: -Provide advice, information, practical and emotional support, to people of all ages affected by sight loss. -Provide a person-centred screening of needs, signposting and referring patients to a wide range of services and organisations -Cultivate positive working relationships to establish and sustain referral routes with a range of health, statutory and third sector organisations. -Provide basic visual awareness training to eye clinic staff and others as required. -Act as a key contact to support patients, family members and carers to navigate their way through the variety of information, advice and support available. -To provide information and guidance on the certification and registration process for people with sight loss. To support eye clinic staff with the processing of the Certificate of Visual Impairment (CVI) -Maintain an up-to-date and comprehensive information resource relating to services available for people with sight loss. -Support patients, family, and carers with advice on falls prevention and refer to available services where appropriate. -When needed, act as an advocate for patients to navigate the complexities of the sight loss pathway to ensure they receive appropriate services. -Maintain accurate patient records and input quality data using multiple IT systems. -Engage patients to gather feedback on the ECLO service. Positively contribute to RNIB evaluation, monitoring and continuous improvement of the service. -Attend local clinical audit meetings, steering groups and other events to promote the benefits of the service to eye clinic and health and social care professionals. -Positively contribute to a range of local and national ECLO team meetings, networks, training, and information events. signal.title: Mantenimiento integral de los elementos de transporte vertical y de intemperie, como ascensores, escaleras mecánicas, rampas y plataforma giratoria
signal.description: La prestación del contrato incluirá los servicios de vigilancia, revisión del estado de las infraestructuras, conservación y mantenimiento, adecuación y renovación de elementos necesarios de las instalaciones que se detallan en el Pliego de Prescripciones Técnicas. Las acciones a realizar para la consecución del objeto de este contrato son las siguientes: - Elaborar el inventario de activos de todos los elementos que son objeto de mantenimiento en este servicio y mantenerlo actualizado durante toda la vida del contrato. - Garantizar el servicio al usuario de la infraestructura, esto es, asegurar la máxima funcionalidad y seguridad de los elementos objeto del pliego en todo momento (24 h/día, 365 días/año), independientemente de las condiciones ambientales o de contorno, mediante una adecuada conservación correctiva gracias a una permanente respuesta inmediata. Mediante la vigilancia del estado de los elementos y seguimiento de las incidencias en los mismos, su gestión técnica y administrativa, así como la reparación de los desperfectos que se detecten en ellos. - Realizar un adecuado proceso preventivo de conservación integral y mantenimiento de los diferentes elementos, de manera que los costes de reposición no alcancen importes cercanos a los que habría que disponer en caso de ruina, alargando la vida útil de los activos y garantizando la fiabilidad del servicio todo ello gracias a un mantenimiento preventivo periódico. Incluye las labores de vigilancia, inspección técnica, trabajos técnicos y administrativos, conservación, mantenimiento y acondicionamiento de los citados elementos con objeto de mantener un índice de calidad igual o superior al que se fije en el pliego de prescripciones técnicas del contrato. - Contar con una herramienta informática de gestión integral del servicio que sea capaz de permitir la administración, organización y monitorización del funcionamiento de los elementos que son objeto de mantenimiento, y garantice el conocimiento del estado de los mismos y los parámetros asociados en tiempo real, así como la consulta histórica de información y esté accesible para los servicios técnicos municipales. - Dar respuesta a las incidencias reportadas por los ciudadanos y los servicios técnicos municipales, haciendo uso del sistema de gestión integral de incidencias con el que cuenta la ciudad.

signal.title: Servicio consistente en trabajos de elaboración, revisión y actualización del inventario general consolidado de la Diputació de Lleida y de sus organismos autónomos
signal.description: Servicios consistentes en trabajos de elaboración, revisión y actualización del Inventario General Consolidado de bienes, derechos y obligaciones que conforman el patrimonio de las siguientes entidades, cualquiera que sea su naturaleza y el título de adquisición o uso: a) El Inventario Consolidado de la Diputació de Lleida. b) El Inventario del Organisme Autònom de Gestió y Recaptació de Tributs Locals (OAGRTL). c) El Inventario del Institut d'Estudis Ilerdencs (IEI). d) El Inventario del Patronat de Promoció Económica (PROMECO). e) El Inventario del Patronat de Turisme. La ejecución del contrato comprende la realización de los siguientes trabajos, de acuerdo con lo establecido en el Pliego de Prescripciones Técnicas:1.Efectuar una investigación previa para recopilar información relativa a los bienes y derechos, salvo aquellos de los que ya dispone la Diputació de Lleida y sus organismos autónomos. Esta parte incluye la consulta de información y documentación en registros, archivos, catastro, etc. 2. Cumplimentar la ficha electrónica del bien y crear el correspondiente expediente electrónico, adjuntando la información y documentación correspondiente al bien o derecho, de conformidad con la cláusula segunda del PPTP. 3.Trasladar al programa GPA todos los bienes y derechos incorporados al inventario, junto con la información y documentación correspondiente. La aplicación informática de gestión patrimonial de la Diputació de Lleida deberá contener toda la información disponible sobre el Patrimonio de la Entidad o, como mínimo, los enlaces que conduzcan a la misma, y deberá permitir realizar búsquedas completas y obtener listados por todos los campos de datos posibles, incluida la fecha de tramitación. Asimismo, deberá permitir su agrupación por subclases de bienes (sobre todo en el caso de los bienes muebles), por adscripción a los usos predefinidos o bien por unidades administrativas y por ubicación.

translation.title: Service consisting of work on the preparation, review and updating of the consolidated general inventory of the Diputació de Lleida and its autonomous bodies
translation.description: Services consisting of work on the preparation, review and updating of the Consolidated General Inventory of assets, rights and obligations that make up the patrimony of the following entities, whatever their nature and the title of acquisition or use: a) The Consolidated Inventory of the Diputació de Lleida. b) The Inventory of the Autonomous Body for the Management and Collection of Local Taxes (OAGRTL). c) The Inventory of the Institute of Lleida Studies (IEI). d) The Inventory of the Board for Economic Promotion (PROMECO). e) The Inventory of the Tourism Board. The execution of the contract comprises the performance of the following work, in accordance with the provisions of the Technical Specifications Document:1.Carry out preliminary research to collect information relating to assets and rights, except those already available to the Diputació de Lleida and its autonomous bodies. This part includes the consultation of information and documentation in registers, archives, cadastre, etc. 2. Complete the electronic form for the asset and create the corresponding electronic file, attaching the information and documentation corresponding to the asset or right, in accordance with clause two of the PPTP. 3.Transfer to the GPA programme all assets and rights incorporated into the inventory, together with the corresponding information and documentation. The asset management computer application of the Diputació de Lleida must contain all available information on the Patrimony of the Entity or, at a minimum, the links leading to it, and must allow comprehensive searches to be performed and lists to be obtained for all possible data fields, including the date of processing. Likewise, it must allow their grouping by subclasses of assets (especially in the case of movable property), by assignment to predefined uses or by administrative units and by location.

signal.title: TIETOPYYNTÖ / Hankinta-asiantuntija- ja juristipalveluiden hankinta 2026
signal.description: 1 JOHDANTO Hankinnan kohteena on hankinta-asiantuntijan ja juristipalvelut. Tätä hankintaa käytetään täydentämään Istekin omia resursseja julkisten hankintojen kilpailuttamisessa ja monipuolisissa juristipalveluissa. Tarkemmin hankinnan kohdetta kuvataan alustavissa hankintamateriaaleissa, jotka toimitetaan erikseen. Pyydämme teitä toimittamaan vastauksenne tähän hankinta‐asiantuntija- ja juristipalveluiden hankintaa koskevaan tietopyyntöön. Arvostamme suuresti kaikkia saamiamme vastauksia, ja jokainen niistä huomioidaan mahdollisen kilpailutuksen valmistelussa. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on varmistaa, että kilpailutuksen valmistelijoilla on käytössään mahdollisimman kattava ja ajantasainen kuva markkinoista sekä tarjolla olevista ratkaisuista. Tällä tietopyynnöllä haluamme kartoittaa toimittajien tarjontaa hankinta‐asiantuntija- ja juristipalveluista sekä palveluiden markkinatilannetta. Lisäksi tarkoituksena on varmistaa kilpailutuksessa käytettävien laadullisten vaatimusten asianmukaisuus. Samalla pyrimme tutustumaan palveluihin mahdollisesti liittyviin tuotteisiin, sopimusehtoihin sekä kaupallisiin ehtoihin, kuten hinnoitteluun. 2 MARKKINAVUOROPUHELUN JÄRJESTÄMINEN Markkinavuoropuhelu tullaan alustavasti järjestämään siten, että tietopyyntöön osallistuneille tarjoajille lähetetään julkaistavat tarjouspyyntömateriaalit kommentoitavaksi. Tietopyynnön vastausten perusteella voidaan järjestää myös markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuksia, joissa toimittajat voivat esitellä omia palveluitaan, tuotteitaan ja vaihtoehtoisia toteutusmalleja kilpailutuksen kohteen toteutukseen liittyen. Mikäli markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuksia järjestetään, ne toteutetaan suomen kielellä. Istekki ilmoittaa tilaisuuksiin osallistuville yrityksille tarkemmat aikataulut sekä Teams-kokouslinkin myöhemmin. 3 TIETOPYYNTÖÖN VASTAAMINEN Pyydämme toimittamaan vastauksenne sähköpostitse osoitteeseen hankinnat@istekki.fi viimeistään 11.3.2026. Toivomme, että vastaukset toimitetaan erillisellä lomakkeella, joka on tämän tietopyynnön liitteenä (Liite 1). On hyvä huomioida, että tämä tietopyyntö ei velvoita Istekki Oy:tä toteuttamaan hankintaa tässä asiakirjassa tai sen liitteissä esitetyllä tavalla. Mahdollinen tarjouskilpailu voidaan myös jättää järjestämättä. Tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta tai esittelytilaisuuksiin osallistumisesta ei makseta erillistä korvausta. Kyseessä on tietopyyntö, ei ennakkoilmoitus, hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on tutustua markkinatilanteeseen ja kerätä hankinnan kohteeseen liittyvää tietoa tulevan kilpailutuksen suunnittelun tueksi. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen on vapaaehtoista, eikä se ole edellytys mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle eikä sido Istekkiä julkaisemaan tarjouskilpailua. Huomioithan, että tässä tietopyynnössä esitetyt tiedot, kuvaukset ja arviot kilpailutuksen aikataulusta ovat alustavia ja suuntaa antavia. Lopulliset aikataulut tarkentuvat valmistelun edetessä. Arvostamme toimittajien antamaa tietoa, sillä se auttaa meitä rakentamaan tulevasta kilpailutuksesta mahdollisimman toimivan ja selkeän kokonaisuuden.

translation.title: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION / Procurement of procurement expert and legal services 2026
translation.description: 1 INTRODUCTION The subject matter of the procurement is procurement expert and legal services. This procurement is used to supplement Istekki's own resources in the competitive tendering of public procurements and versatile legal services. The subject matter of the procurement is described in more detail in the preliminary procurement materials, which will be delivered separately. We kindly ask you to submit your response to this request for information concerning the procurement of procurement expert and legal services. We greatly appreciate all the responses we receive, and each of them will be taken into account in the preparation of a potential competitive tendering procedure. The purpose of the request for information is to ensure that those preparing the competitive tendering have as comprehensive and up-to-date a picture of the market and available solutions as possible. With this request for information, we want to map out suppliers' offerings of procurement expert and legal services as well as the market situation for the services. In addition, the purpose is to ensure the appropriateness of the qualitative requirements used in the competitive tendering. At the same time, we aim to familiarise ourselves with products, contract terms and commercial terms, such as pricing, that may be related to the services. 2 ORGANISING THE MARKET DIALOGUE The market dialogue is provisionally to be organised in such a way that the publishable invitation to tender materials will be sent to the tenderers who have participated in the request for information for comments. Based on the responses to the request for information, market dialogue sessions may also be organised where suppliers can present their own services, products and alternative implementation models related to the implementation of the subject matter of the competitive tendering. If market dialogue sessions are organised, they will be conducted in the Finnish language. Istekki will notify the companies participating in the sessions of the more detailed schedules and the Teams meeting link at a later date. 3 RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST FOR INFORMATION We kindly ask you to submit your response by email to the address hankinnat@istekki.fi no later than 11.3.2026. We hope that the responses will be submitted using the separate form attached to this request for information (Appendix 1). It is worth noting that this request for information does not oblige Istekki Oy to carry out the procurement in the manner presented in this document or its appendices. A potential competitive tendering procedure may also not be organised. No separate compensation will be paid for responding to the request for information or participating in presentation sessions. This is a request for information, not a prior information notice, contract notice or invitation to tender. The purpose of the request for information is to familiarise oneself with the market situation and gather information related to the subject matter of the procurement to support the planning of future competitive tendering. Responding to the request for information is voluntary and is not a prerequisite for participation in a potential competitive tendering procedure, nor does it bind Istekki to publish a competitive tendering procedure. Please note that the information, descriptions and estimates of the schedule for the competitive tendering presented in this request for information are preliminary and indicative. The final schedules will be refined as the preparation progresses. We appreciate the information provided by suppliers, as it helps us build the future competitive tendering into as functional and clear a whole as possible.

signal.title: DVLA Payments Out
signal.description: This is a Prior Information Notice (PIN) with the purpose of assisting the Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) in engaging the market by gathering information. This PIN has the purpose of a fact-finding exercise and only. Background Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) are exploring options to digitalise payments out of the Agency in a bid to reduce payable orders. A specific user case includes invoice-based payments. Invoices are returned with information to support a customer's application. These applications, information and invoices are currently paper based which are scanned and digitalised in-house. On receipt of the information and sufficient checks, a payment is made by payable order to those named on the invoice. The payable order process is also managed in-house and posted from DVLA. Volumes In this example, for the financial year 2025-26, 221,406 individual payable orders were issued, with a net value of approximately £14.8M. Considerations - The payments are made to anyone qualified to complete the supporting evidence, so there is no static list of payees. There could be around 60,000 individual payees which fluctuates. Some are repeat payees and some are one off payees. - The payees include individuals and company accounts from across the UK. - The invoices (currently paper based) include the payee bank information (account number, sort code). - The invoices are then scanned and a digital copy held. - As a Government Agency we are required to follow all HM Treasury guidance outlined in the 'Managing Public Money' published documentation. - This includes not being able to use intermediary bank accounts outside of the Exchequer pyramid. - DVLA do not have an existing BACs business as usual process for payments out. - DVLA has explored Open Banking for this user case and feel that due to the considerations above it doesn't fully meet our requirements. Project aims - Digitalise movement of funds - Reduce/remove payable orders - Improve invoice management processes - Improve customer experience Information required - Potential solutions to support the project aims aligned to the considerations - Any costs associated with developing and implementing the solution including any licences or additional external costs. - Any ongoing costs associated with ongoing running of the solution. - Time taken to develop and implement the solution. - Any wider considerations, fees or any other supporting information. - Do you provide this type of service for any other large organisations? - How can DVLA procure from your organisation? e.g. Are they on a framework? If so which one? Do we need to go through any third parties to obtain their services? Please provide a response via email to the above question to Michelle Palmer - Michelle.Palmer@dvla.gov.uk by 5pm on May 13th 2026

signal.title: Data of Last Resort Data Collection
signal.description: This Market Engagement seeks to identify options to enable procurement of a dedicated backup collection tool for Operational Technology (OT) environments. The solution will ensure that the complete data state of critical OT assets is consistently captured and securely stored across multiple sites, serving as the organisation's data of last resort. The tool must collect the full backup state of OT assets including configurations, control logic, firmware, hardware metadata, and associated files. It must support both automated, policy-driven backup collection and authorised manual backup initiation, operating through secure and non-intrusive protocols that do not interact with OT control or programming interfaces and have no impact on live operations or safety-critical systems. The solution must be vendor-agnostic, deployable fully on-premise or within a private cloud, and capable of operating in air-gapped environments, with full audit trails and compliance reporting. IMPORTANT: Please read this section before deciding whether you wish to register for this event. This section provides you with information regarding the scope of this procurement and details some of the key requirements that a successful applicant MUST be able to deliver.

signal.title: FSF Dynamic Purchasing System 2 For the Provision of Work Focused Activities
signal.description: The Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) established a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) to procure Work Focused Activities for Jobcentre Plus Districts in England, Scotland and Wales via the previous DWP eProcurement Solution (ePS). DWP has now migrated to a new ePS, Atamis and DWP are therefore reissuing this notice via the Atamis portal. However, please note that 'online' applications to join the FSF DPS 2 via the Atamis Portal are currently suspended and a temporary 'offline' process is in place, further details are below. The DPS is for the procurement of social and other services referred to in Regulation 74 of the Public Contracts Regulations (2015) and as such, the intention is to use a light touch regime, rather than the full regime described in Regulation 34 (Dynamic Purchasing System). The DPS is for the sole use of DWP. The Flexible Support Fund Dynamic Purchasing System 2 - For the Provision of Work Focused Activities (FSF DPS 2) is the replacement for the DWP Dynamic Purchasing System for provision of work-focused activities known as the Flexible Support Fund DPS (FSF DPS). The FSF DPS expired on 31 October 2021 and was replaced by the FSF DPS 2 with effect from 1 November 2021. Currently the 'online' application process is suspended, and a temporary 'offline' process is in operation. Any new supplier wishing to apply to join the FSF DPS 2 should send an email to cdfsf.adhocprocurement@dwp.gov.uk requesting to apply to join the FSF DPS 2, and the relevant information will be sent to you via email. Although DWP are currently operating an 'offline' process to join the FSF DPS 2, suppliers will still be required to create an account on Atamis. Suppliers can do this via the link below, which will take you to the DWP Atamis landing page. To ensure that the page functions correctly, you must accept browser cookies https://dwp2.my.site.com/s/Welcome From this landing page, new suppliers will be able to create an Atamis account by selecting the "Supplier Registration Here" button and following the on screen instructions. The landing page also has a link to the Supplier Portal Help page, where you will find an article to help with registering for an account https://suppliersupport.atamis.co.uk/hc/en-gb/articles/4613254620319-Registering-with-a-Supplier-Portal Estimated overall value of this DPS will be £250,000,000.00 Additional Information As of 1 January 2021, the internationally comparable regional geography for the UK is the International Territorial Levels (ITLs) geography. This has replaced the Nomenclature of territorial units for statistics (NUTS) geographies for the UK that were operational when the UK was a member of the European Union. Please refer to the spreadsheet to see how the NUTS Code correspond to the ITL Codes at Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3.

signal.title: Pump Optimisation and Aeration Efficiency Analysis
signal.description: IMPORTANT: Please read this section before deciding whether you wish to register for this event. This section provides you with information regarding the scope of this procurement and details some of the key requirements that a successful applicant MUST be able to deliver. Thames Water intends to establish a single-lot, sole-supplier framework agreement for the provision of pump optimisation and aeration efficiency services across Thames Water operational assets. The scope of the framework includes monitoring, testing, and analysis of pumping and aeration systems and associated equipment. The objective is to identify and deliver opportunities to reduce whole-life costs, improve efficiency, and optimise performance across operational sites. The contract will include: - Fixed pricing structures with agreed review mechanisms. - Key performance indicators (KPIs) and performance monitoring requirements to ensure delivery against expected outcomes. - Requirements to support collaborative working and a transition from transactional delivery to strategic partnership. Suppliers will be expected to support a culture of continuous improvement and contribute to ongoing enhancement of processes and delivery approaches throughout the contract lifecycle. Delivery Model The anticipated delivery model will follow a structured approach comprising: - Initial site identification and data collection. - Project mobilisation and stakeholder engagement. - Efficiency and control studies to identify optimisation opportunities. - Approval to proceed to testing and monitoring. - Site-based testing and performance monitoring activities. - Review of outcomes, including business case validation. - Handover for delivery through relevant engineering or capital delivery mechanisms. The contract is expected to support a programme of approximately 200 tests across 60 operational sites during the AMP period. Further detail on the scope, service requirements, and call-off mechanisms will be provided within the procurement and contract documents. The following conditions would be considered as some of key requirements for a supplier to meet to be considered for this opportunity: • Must be able to cover the Thames Valley, London and Home Counties geographical area • Must have a proven track record in delivering measurable savings and innovation within the scope of this framework. Thames Water reserves the right to refine the award criteria. Please note that that deadline for asking for access to the PSQ & submitting of the PSQ is 19 October 2026, at 12:00pm. Lot 1: .

signal.title: PR Agency Services
signal.description: Synchronicity Care Limited on behalf of Fresh and Balance are seeking a provider of PR Agency Services. Fresh and Balance is the North East's integrated programme for reducing tobacco and alcohol harm in the region. They are one single joint programme carrying out much of the public and partner facing work under the two separate, well recognised brands of Fresh and Balance. Fresh and Balance remit is to reduce smoking rates and the harm caused by tobacco and alcohol amongst the local population and key audiences using a multi-strand approach based on best national and international evidence. This includes mass media campaigns, campaigning and advocacy, effective internal communications, and making voices heard on the national stage to politicians and decision makers. A key element of their work and priority of local funders is the delivery of all year round news and social media reach/engagement to ensure issues and messages in the public eye all year round on the channels that people see, read and hear, providing a highly cost effective return on investment. This also involves working with a range of senior stakeholders for messengers and champions, building support for measures to reduce smoking and harmful drinking, motivating and triggering behaviour change, and engaging and motivating key partners to prioritise these agendas regionally and nationally. Communications cover three main strands: • Behaviour change - highlighting the risks and signposting positive behaviour change around quitting smoking, reducing second hand smoke and reducing drinking - via campaigns, socials and two key websites FreshQuit.co.uk and ReduceMyRisk.tv. • Highlighting the harm - the cost of tobacco and alcohol across the region and nationally to motivate regional stakeholders and the public • Campaigning for change - a strong policy focus to call for more action nationally on tobacco and alcohol, increasing public and partner support for this. This also includes an increasing focus on building partnerships across the health system, local communities and community and voluntary sector. Fresh and Balance are looking for a PR agency with the experience, skills and knowledge to develop communications across the increasing range of available media channels to secure content - both traditional and online. Since we are a joint programme, this will be one contract serving both campaign brands, while still requiring the insight and experience in social marketing approaches to plan campaigns and approaches around both tobacco and alcohol. The successful agency will be expected to provide PR support to support the programme from 1st April 2027 with the potential for contract extensions and subject to satisfactory performance and reviews and funding. A key element of their work and priority of local funders is the delivery of all year round news and social media reach/engagement to ensure issues and messages in the public eye all year round on the channels that people see, read and hear, providing a highly cost effective return on investment. This also involves working with a range of senior stakeholders for messengers and champions, building support for measures to reduce smoking and harmful drinking, motivating and triggering behaviour change, and engaging and motivating key partners to prioritise these agendas regionally and nationally. Communications cover three main strands: • Behaviour change - highlighting the risks and signposting positive behaviour change around quitting smoking, reducing second hand smoke and reducing drinking - via campaigns, socials and two key websites FreshQuit.co.uk and ReduceMyRisk.tv. • Highlighting the harm - the cost of tobacco and alcohol across the region and nationally to motivate regional stakeholders and the public • Campaigning for change - a strong policy focus to call for more action nationally on tobacco and alcohol, increasing public and partner support for this. This also includes an increasing focus on building partnerships across the health system, local communities and community and voluntary sector. Fresh and Balance are looking for a PR agency with the experience, skills and knowledge to develop communications across the increasing range of available media channels to secure content - both traditional and online. Since we are a joint programme, this will be one contract serving both campaign brands, while still requiring the insight and experience in social marketing approaches to plan campaigns and approaches around both tobacco and alcohol. The successful agency will be expected to provide PR support to support the programme from 1st April 2027 with the potential for contract extensions and subject to satisfactory performance and reviews and funding. signal.title: Digitale Geschäftsreise im Rahmen der Exportinitiative Energie des BMWE 2027, 2. Tranche
signal.description: Das Ziel der Exportinitiative Energie (EIE) des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie (BMWE) ist es, deutsche Unternehmen (UN), die klimafreundliche Energielösungen anbieten, beim Markteintritt im Ausland zu unterstützen und deutsche Produkte und Dienstleistungen international zu positionieren. Ein fester Bestandteil des Förderangebots ist das Energie-Geschäftsreiseprogramm. Ziel der (digitalen) Energie-Geschäftsreisen ist es, den Markteinstieg für deutsche KMU durch den Aufbau von fundierten Marktkenntnissen sowie die gezielte Kontaktvermittlung zu potenziellen Geschäftspartnern in den jeweiligen Zielmärkten vorzubereiten und bestehende Auslandsaktivitäten deutscher KMU weiter auszubauen. Das Fördermodul digitale Energie-Geschäftsreise (dGR) besteht aus einem Reisesteckbrief, einer Zielmarktanalyse (ZMA), einem Online-Briefing sowie einer online durchgeführten Fachkonferenz. Das zentrale Element der Maßnahme sind individuelle Gespräche der deutschen UN für eine gezielte Geschäftsanbahnung mit potenziellen Geschäftspartnerinnen und Gesprächspartnern des Ziellandes. Lot LOT-0000: Los 1 - Fidschi, Cookinseln, Samoa, Tonga Hybrid-Mini-Grids (inkl. Kleinwasser und Grid-Modernisierung). Zielland : Fidschi, Cookinseln, Samoa, Tonga Anwendungsfeld : Energieerzeugung Möglicher Termin : Q4 2027 Zielsetzung : Die digital durchgeführte Energie-Geschäftsreise soll deutschen KMU aus den Bereichen Hybrid-Mini-Grids sowie Grid-Modernisierung die Markterschließung erleichtern. Im Mittelpunkt der virtuell durchgeführten Geschäftsreise stehen die gezielte Kontaktvermittlung und individuelle B2B-Gespräche mit potenziellen Kunden, Partnern und relevanten Stakeholdern aus der Zielregion. Im Besonderen soll der Zielmarkt Fidschi in den Fokus gerückt werden. Die Märkte Cookinseln, Samoa, Tonga können als zusätzliche Absatzmärkte in die dGR mit einfließen. Die Maßnahme richtet sich an deutsche KMU mit Lösungen in den Bereichen Batteriespeicher und Energiemanagement, SCADA/Leittechnik und Digitalisierung, Wechselrichter/Power-Electronics und Schutztechnik, Systemdesign/Hybrid-Optimierung sowie O&M-Konzepte/Schulung. Hinweis : Es soll eine längere regionale ZMA verfasst werden (Sonderversion), die Fidschi, Cookinseln, Samoa und Tonga umfasst. Die im Leitfaden beschriebenen Vorgaben sind bei der Projektumsetzung anzuwenden.

translation.title: Digital business trip within the framework of the Energy Export Initiative of the BMWE 2027, 2. Tranche
translation.description: The objective of the Energy Export Initiative (EIE) of the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BMWE) is to support German companies offering climate-friendly energy solutions with market entry abroad and to position German products and services internationally. A fixed component of the funding offer is the energy business trip programme. The aim of the (digital) energy business trips is to prepare market entry for German SMEs through the building of sound market knowledge and targeted matchmaking with potential business partners in the respective target markets, and to further expand the existing foreign activities of German SMEs. The digital energy business trip (dGR) funding module consists of a travel profile, a target market analysis (ZMA), an online briefing and an online specialist conference. The central element of the measure is individual meetings of the German companies for targeted business initiation with potential business partners and interlocutors of the target country. Lot LOT-0000: Lot 1 - Fiji, Cook Islands, Samoa, Tonga Hybrid mini-grids (incl. small hydro and grid modernisation). Target country : Fiji, Cook Islands, Samoa, Tonga Application field : Energy generation Possible date : Q4 2027 Objective : The digitally conducted energy business trip is intended to make market development easier for German SMEs from the fields of hybrid mini-grids and grid modernisation. The focus of the virtually conducted business trip is targeted matchmaking and individual B2B meetings with potential clients, partners and relevant stakeholders from the target region. In particular, the target market of Fiji is to be brought into focus. The markets of Cook Islands, Samoa, Tonga can be incorporated into the dGR as additional sales markets. The measure is aimed at German SMEs with solutions in the areas of battery storage and energy management, SCADA/control technology and digitalisation, inverters/power electronics and protection technology, system design/hybrid optimisation, and O&M concepts/training. Note : A longer regional ZMA (special version) is to be written, covering Fiji, Cook Islands, Samoa and Tonga. The specifications described in the guidelines are to be applied during project implementation.

Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Dokumentation von fest installierten Projektionsleinwänden für Räume für kommunale Sitzungen (Besprechungs-räume, Sitzungssäle oder ähnliche) und Service. Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere: • Aufmaß vor Ort • Lieferung der Leinwände einschließlich sämtlicher Befestigungsmaterialien • Demontage und Entsorgung von Altleinwänden (im Einzelfall) • Montage und betriebsfertige Installation • elektrische Anbindung bei Motorsteuerung • Funktionsprüfung • Einweisung des Auftraggebers (bei einziehbaren Leinwänden) • Übergabe der Dokumentation • Entsorgung von Verpackungsmaterial Die Installation erfolgt in der Regel in Bestandsgebäuden während des laufenden Betriebs. In Einzelfällen erfolgt die Installation im Rahmen einer Neugestaltung eines Sitzungs- oder Be-sprechungsraumes. Lot LOT-0005: Mobile Projektionsleinwände. Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung von mobilen Projektleinwänden einschließlich Transporttaschen für den flexiblen Einsatz in kommunalen Sitzungs-, Besprechungs- und Veranstaltungsräumen. Die Leinwände werden für wechselnde Einsatzorte innerhalb kommunaler Liegenschaften verwendet und müssen von einer Person transportiert, aufgebaut und betrieben werden können. Die Lieferung umfasst: • Mobile Projektionsleinwand • Stand- bzw. Tragesystem • Transport- und Schutztasche • Bedienungsanleitung • Garantienachweise • Lieferung an den Erfüllungsort Lot LOT-0006: Ultra-mobile Medien- und Präsentationssysteme. Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung eines vollständig integrierten, ultra-mobilen Medienwagens zur Durchführung von: • Ratssitzungen • Ausschusssitzungen • Hybriden Gremiensitzungen • Hybriden Bürgerversammlungen Die Bedienung erfolgt durch wechselnde Nutzende ohne besondere medientechnische Kenntnisse. Die Lösung muss als kompakte All-in-one-Einheit ausgeführt sein und sämtliche Komponenten zur Bild-, Ton- und Sprachübertragung beinhalten. Lot LOT-0007: Fest installierte Deckenprojektoren (Beamer). Gegenstand dieses Loses sind sämtliche Leistungen zur betriebsbereiten Übergabe eines fest installierten Projektionssystems bestehend aus Deckenprojektor(en), Deckenhalterung(en), Signalübertragung, Steuerungstechnik, Verkabelung sowie sämtlichem für den Betrieb erforderlichen Zubehör einschließlich Planung, Montage, Verkabelung, Konfiguration, Einweisung und Dokumentation sowie Service. Das System dient der Darstellung von Präsentationen, Sitzungsunterlagen, Videokonferenzen, Livestreams und sonstigen medialen Inhalten in Rats-, Ausschuss-, Besprechungs- und Konferenzräumen. Lot LOT-0008: Mobile Projektoren (Beamer). Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Einrichtung und betriebsbereite Übergabe mobiler Projektionssysteme (Beamer) einschließlich Transportzubehör, Anschlusskabeln und aller für den Betrieb erforderlichen Komponenten sowie Service. Die Geräte dienen der flexiblen Nutzung in Rats-, Ausschuss-, Besprechungs-, Schulungs- und Veranstaltungsräumen zur Darstellung von Präsentationen, Sitzungsunterlagen, Videokonferenzen und multimedialen Inhalten. Die Projektoren müssen ohne feste Installation an unterschiedlichen Standorten innerhalb der Verwaltung einsetzbar sein. Lot LOT-0009: Smartboards (Interaktive All-in-one Collaboration Boards) . Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und betriebsbereite Übergabe interaktiver All-in-one Collaboration Boards mit integriertem Touchdisplay, Whiteboard-Funktion, Videokonferenztechnik, Lautsprechersystem, Mikrofonarray und Bildschirmfreigabe sowie Service. Die Systeme dienen der Durchführung von Präsenz-, Hybrid- und Videokonferenzen sowie der gemeinsamen Bearbeitung von Dokumenten, Präsentationen und Sitzungs-unterlagen. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt Lieferung, Montage, Konfiguration, Inbetriebnahme, Dokumentation, Schulung und Support. Lot LOT-0010: Fest installierte Beschallung. Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Einmessung eines fest installierten Beschallungssystems für die Sprachübertragung in Gremien-, Ausschuss- und Besprechungsräume sowie Service. Das System dient der Unterstützung von Präsenz-, Hybrid- und Videokonferenzen und ist für einen dauerhaften Betrieb in kommunalen Sitzungsräumen ausgelegt. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt sämtliche zur betriebsbereiten Übergabe erforderlichen Leistungen einschließlich Vor-Ort-Termin zur Bestandsaufnahme, Fachplanung, Verkabelung, Montage, Konfiguration, Dokumentation, Einweisung und Service. Lot LOT-0011: Mobile Konferenzlautsprecher. Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung von mobilen Konferenzlautsprechern (Speakerphones/Soundbar) zur Nutzung in Sitzungs-, Besprechungs- und Gremienräumen sowie Service. Die Geräte dienen der Durchführung von Präsenz-, Hybrid- und Videokonferenzen mit mehreren Teilnehmern und müssen mit gängigen Konferenzplattformen kompatibel sein. Lot LOT-0012: Konferenzmikrofone. Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Einrichtung, Inbetriebnahme und betriebsbereite Übergabe eines drahtlosen digitalen Konferenzmikrofonsystems für Rats-, Ausschuss-, Bei-rats- und Gremiensitzungen. Das System besteht aus Mitglieds- und Präsidiumssprechstellen einschließlich Schwanenhalsmikrofonen, integrierten Lautsprechern, Akkusystemen, Ladeinfrastruktur, Steuerungseinheit, Zubehör sowie sämtlichen für den Betrieb erforderlichen Komponenten. Das System muss für Präsenzsitzungen, hybride Sitzungen, Livestreams, Aufzeichnungen sowie die Anbindung an Videokonferenzsysteme geeignet sein. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt Planung, Lieferung, Konfiguration, Inbetriebnahme, Einweisung, Dokumentation und Service. Lot LOT-0013: Handmikrofone mit Ständer. Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Aufbau, Inbetriebnahme und betriebsbereite Übergabe eines professionellen drahtlosen Handmikrofonsystems einschließlich Mikrofonständern, Ladeeinrichtungen, Funkempfängern, Zubehör und aller zur Nutzung erforderlichen Komponenten. Das System dient der Sprachübertragung bei Rats-, Ausschuss-, Beirats-, Besprechungs- und Hybridveranstaltungen sowie öffentlichen Sitzungen. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt sämtliche zur betriebsbereiten Übergabe erforderlichen Leistungen einschließlich Lieferung, Aufbau, Konfiguration, Frequenzplanung, Einmessung, Dokumentation und Einweisung sowie Service. Lot LOT-0014: PTZ-Raumkamerasysteme. Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Montage, Einrichtung, Inbetriebnahme und betriebs-bereite Übergabe von professionellen PTZ-Raumkameras (Pan-Tilt-Zoom) zur Nutzung in Be-sprechungs-, Konferenz-, Ausschuss- und Ratssälen. Die Kameras dienen der hochwertigen Videoerfassung von Sitzungen, Besprechungen, Videokonferenzen, Livestreams und hybriden Veranstaltungen. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt sämtliche Leistungen einschließlich Planung, Vor-Ort-Aufmaß, Lieferung, Montage, Verkabelung, Konfiguration, Inbetriebnahme, Dokumentation und Einweisung sowie Service. Lot LOT-0015: Mobile 360-Grad-Konferenzkamerasysteme. Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Einrichtung und betriebsbereite Übergabe mobiler intelligenter Konferenzkamerasysteme für Rats-, Ausschuss-, Besprechungs-, Schulungs- und Konferenzräume sowie Service. Die Systeme müssen eine vollumfängliche Audio- und Videoerfassung von Präsenzteilnehmenden ermöglichen und für hybride Sitzungen sowie Videokonferenzen geeignet sein. Die Systeme bestehen mindestens aus: • Kamerasystem • Mikrofonarray • Lautsprechersystem • Netzteil • Anschlusskabeln • Transportzubehör (Transporttasche oder Transportkoffer) • erforderlicher Software Lot LOT-0016: Frontale Videokonferenzkamerasysteme (Videobars) . Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Montage, Einrichtung, Inbetriebnahme und betriebs-bereite Übergabe von frontalen Videokonferenzkamerasystemen (Videobars) für Besprechungs-, Konferenz-, Ausschuss-, Schulungs- und Gremienräume sowie Service. Die Systeme müssen Kamera, Mikrofonarray und Lautsprechersystem in einem Gerät integrieren und für hybride Sitzungen, Videokonferenzen, digitale Zusammenarbeit und Präsentationen geeignet sein. Die Systeme sind insbesondere für die Montage an oder unter interaktiven Displays, Smartboards oder Großbildschirmen vorgesehen. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt Lieferung, Dokumentation und Support. Lot LOT-0017: Zubehör für Medien-, Präsentations- und Konferenztechnik. Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Einrichtung und betriebsbereite Übergabe von Zubehörkomponenten für die Medien-, Präsentations- und Konferenztechnik sowie Service. Die Komponenten dienen der Signalübertragung, Anbindung mobiler Endgeräte, Erweiterung von Präsentationssystemen sowie der Verwaltung mehrerer Signalquellen innerhalb von Besprechungs-, Schulungs-, Konferenz- und Gremienräumen. Der Auftragnehmer liefert sämtliche Zubehörkomponenten einschließlich notwendiger Adapter, Anschlussleitungen und Dokumentationen.

translation.title: Hardware for hybrid video conferences
translation.description:
Framework agreement for the supply of conference, presentation and media technology including the provision of lot-related associated services for the purpose of holding video conferences as part of hybrid committee meetings of municipal call-off authorised entities in Schleswig-Holstein Lot LOT-0001: On-site advice Region North. Region North: District of Nordfriesland, District of Schleswig-Flensburg, City of Flensburg Lot LOT-0002: On-site advice Region Centre. Region Centre: District of Dithmarschen, District of Plön, District of Rendsburg-Eckernförde, District of Steinburg, City of Kiel, City of Neumünster Lot LOT-0003: On-site advice Region South. Region South: District of Ostholstein, District of Segeberg, District of Pinneberg, District of Stormarn, District of Herzogtum-Lauenburg, City of Lübeck Lot LOT-0004: Fixed projection screens. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery, assembly, commissioning and documentation of permanently installed projection screens for municipal meeting rooms (meeting rooms, conference rooms or similar) and service. The services comprise in particular: • On-site measurement • Delivery of the screens including all fastening materials • Dismantling and disposal of old screens (in individual cases) • Assembly and ready-for-operation installation • electrical connection for motor control • Functional testing • Instruction of the client (for retractable screens) • Handover of documentation • Disposal of packaging material Installation is generally carried out in existing buildings during ongoing operation. In individual cases, installation takes place as part of the redesign of a meeting or conference room. Lot LOT-0005: Mobile projection screens. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery of mobile projection screens including transport bags for flexible use in municipal meeting, conference and event rooms. The screens are used for changing locations within municipal properties and must be able to be transported, set up and operated by one person. The delivery includes: • Mobile projection screen • Stand or carrying system • Transport and protective bag • Operating instructions • Warranty certificates • Delivery to the place of performance Lot LOT-0006: Ultra-mobile media and presentation systems. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery of a fully integrated, ultra-mobile media trolley for the implementation of: • Council meetings • Committee meetings • Hybrid committee meetings • Hybrid citizen assemblies Operation is carried out by changing users without special media technology knowledge. The solution must be designed as a compact all-in-one unit and contain all components for image, sound and voice transmission. Lot LOT-0007: Permanently installed ceiling projectors (beamers). The subject matter of this lot is all services for the operational handover of a permanently installed projection system consisting of ceiling projector(s), ceiling mount(s), signal transmission, control technology, cabling and all accessories required for operation including planning, assembly, cabling, configuration, instruction and documentation as well as service. The system is used to display presentations, meeting documents, video conferences, live streams and other media content in council, committee, meeting and conference rooms. Lot LOT-0008: Mobile projectors (beamers). The subject matter of this lot is the delivery, setup and operational handover of mobile projection systems (beamers) including transport accessories, connection cables and all components required for operation as well as service. The devices are used for flexible use in council, committee, meeting, training and event rooms for displaying presentations, meeting documents, video conferences and multimedia content. The projectors must be usable at different locations within the administration without permanent installation. Lot LOT-0009: Smartboards (Interactive All-in-one Collaboration Boards). The subject matter of this lot is the delivery, assembly, commissioning and operational handover of interactive all-in-one collaboration boards with an integrated touch display, whiteboard function, video conferencing technology, loudspeaker system, microphone array and screen sharing as well as service. The systems are used to hold in-person, hybrid and video conferences as well as for the joint processing of documents, presentations and meeting documents. The contractor takes over delivery, assembly, configuration, commissioning, documentation, training and support. Lot LOT-0010: Permanently installed sound reinforcement. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery, assembly, commissioning and calibration of a permanently installed sound reinforcement system for voice transmission in committee, board and meeting rooms as well as service. The system is used to support in-person, hybrid and video conferences and is designed for continuous operation in municipal meeting rooms. The contractor assumes all services required for operational handover including an on-site appointment for inventory assessment, specialist planning, cabling, assembly, configuration, documentation, instruction and service. Lot LOT-0011: Mobile conference speakers. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery of mobile conference speakers (speakerphones/soundbars) for use in meeting, conference and committee rooms as well as service. The devices are used to hold in-person, hybrid and video conferences with multiple participants and must be compatible with common conference platforms. Lot LOT-0012: Conference microphones. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery, setup, commissioning and operational handover of a wireless digital conference microphone system for council, committee, advisory board and committee meetings.

The system consists of member and presiding committee microphone stations including gooseneck microphones, integrated loudspeakers, battery systems, charging infrastructure, control unit, accessories and all components required for operation. The system must be suitable for face-to-face meetings, hybrid meetings, live streams, recordings and connection to video conferencing systems. The contractor shall undertake planning, delivery, configuration, commissioning, instruction, documentation and service. Lot LOT-0013: Handheld microphones with stand. The subject of this lot is the delivery, assembly, commissioning and operational handover of a professional wireless handheld microphone system including microphone stands, charging facilities, radio receivers, accessories and all components required for use. The system is used for speech transmission at council, committee, advisory board, meeting and hybrid events as well as public sessions. The contractor shall undertake all services required for operational handover including delivery, assembly, configuration, frequency planning, acoustic measurement, documentation and instruction as well as service. Lot LOT-0014: PTZ room camera systems. The subject of this lot is the delivery, installation, setup, commissioning and operational handover of professional PTZ room cameras (pan-tilt-zoom) for use in meeting, conference, committee and council halls. The cameras are used for high-quality video capture of sessions, meetings, video conferences, live streams and hybrid events. The contractor shall undertake all services including planning, on-site measurements, delivery, installation, cabling, configuration, commissioning, documentation and instruction as well as service. Lot LOT-0015: Mobile 360-degree conference camera systems. The subject of this lot is the delivery, setup and operational handover of mobile intelligent conference camera systems for council, committee, meeting, training and conference rooms as well as service. The systems must enable comprehensive audio and video capture of in-person participants and be suitable for hybrid meetings and video conferences. The systems shall consist at least of: • Camera system • Microphone array • Loudspeaker system • Power supply unit • Connection cables • Transport accessories (transport bag or transport case) • Required software Lot LOT-0016: Frontal video conference camera systems (videobars). The subject of this lot is the delivery, installation, setup, commissioning and operational handover of frontal video conference camera systems (videobars) for meeting, conference, committee, training and body rooms as well as service. The systems must integrate camera, microphone array and loudspeaker system into a single device and be suitable for hybrid meetings, video conferences, digital collaboration and presentations. The systems are intended in particular for mounting on or beneath interactive displays, smartboards or large screens. The contractor shall undertake delivery, documentation and support. Lot LOT-0017: Accessories for media, presentation and conference technology. The subject of this lot is the delivery, setup and operational handover of accessory components for media, presentation and conference technology as well as service. The components are used for signal transmission, connection of mobile terminal devices, expansion of presentation systems and management of multiple signal sources within meeting, training, conference and body rooms. The contractor shall supply all accessory components including necessary adapters, connecting cables and documentation.

signal.title: Servicio de mantenimiento integral de los edificios e instalaciones de la Universidad de Cantabria.
signal.description: El Servicio de Mantenimiento Integral de los Edificios e Instalaciones de la Universidad de Cantabria consiste en la realización de los mantenimientos normativos, preventivos y correctivos de las instalaciones de la Universidad, abarcando todos los oficios detallados en el Pliego de Prescripciones Técnicas correspondiente (albañilería, carpintería, pintura, calefacción, gas, fontanería, instalaciones eléctricas, instalaciones térmicas, red informática, telefonía, megafonía, climatización y refrigeración, sistemas de control y puertas automáticas y portones). El Servicio comprende un trabajo planificado y conocido de antemano (mantenimientos normativos y preventivos) y trabajos correctivos derivados de fallos o averías en las instalaciones y/o equipos. El contratista debe suministrar los materiales requeridos para la correcta ejecución de sus actuaciones, ya sean normativas, preventivas o correctivas. Es necesaria la iniciación del procedimiento para la contratación de este servicio, pues la Universidad debe cumplir la normativa vigente y garantizar el funcionamiento continuo y eficaz de los edificios e instalaciones. La complejidad y variedad de las instalaciones universitarias aconseja la gestión integral de sus mantenimientos para que de forma coordinada se desarrolle y fomente la actividad preventiva y se realicen las reparaciones necesarias en todos los oficios incluidos en este servicio. La Universidad de Cantabria no dispone de personal cualificado ni sistemas técnicos adecuados para garantizar la conservación y mantenimiento de los edificios, instalaciones y equipos de la Universidad de Cantabria en las materias de albañilería, carpintería, pintura, calefacción, gas, fontanería, instalaciones eléctricas, instalaciones térmicas, red informática, telefonía, megafonía, climatización y refrigeración, sistemas de control y puertas automáticas y portones.
